race.comment: MEAN APPROACH (1) hasn't done much wrong this campaign and comes through some great form races. Draws well for in-form apprentice Williams and is sure to be right there at the business end. FACUNDO (3) made the perfect return here when getting the bob and progressed well second up when placing in a tougher grade. Will find this a bit easier third up and should be hitting his straps. Pozman's 3kg claim helps further. Impossible to knock the form of GRAM (5), who shoots for six straight but will need to raise the bar again. ABENDER (13) was too bad to be true first up and has been kept fresh with 42 days in between. Can improve sharply. PROVANCE (14) is building nicely and sets up well for this down in the weights.
